text_block_list.name: Machikane Fukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Lucky come-come♪ Happy come-come♪ Thank you, Shiraoki-samaaa!!

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text: —Good morning, Fukukitaru. That's a delightful song. Did something good happen?

text_block_list.name: Machikane Fukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Yes! This morning's pencil fortune gave me Great Fortune! Today is definitely going to be packed with happiness~!!

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text: Fufufu, now even I'm looking forward to the day. May it be a wonderful one.

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text: What should I have for lunch? Yesterday was a sandwich, so—

text_block_list.name: Machikane Fukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Y-Y-Yaaaah!?

text_block_list.name: Machikane Fukukitaru
text_block_list.text: The limited-quantity special menu item is still available! As expected of Great Fortune! Truly lucky!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: What a coincidence. That's one of my favorite menu items too. Would you like to eat together, if you don't mind?

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text: Phew, that was delicious. Time to head back to the classroom...

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text: Ah, Fukukitaru! I saw what happened earlier. I'm glad you got the limited-menu—

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...Fukukitaru?

text_block_list.name: Machikane Fukukitaru
text_block_list.text: T-Truly terrifying... Oguri-san's go-to meal... The "Super-Volcano Ascension☆Omurice"... Urgh!

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text: H-Hang in there...!?

text_block_list.name: Machikane Fukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Phew, what a pleasant breeze~ On a day like this, muscle workouts make great progress—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WHOOOOSH! Flutter-flutter~)

text_block_list.name: Machikane Fukukitaru
text_block_list.text: A-Ah, that's--!! Wait for me~~!! My lucky scarf that I hung out to dryyy!!

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text: Ah. Fukukitaru, again...

text_block_list.name: Machikane Fukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Good grief, strong wind, gale-force wind. Let's do our workout indoors today—

text_block_list.name: Machikane Fukukitaru
text_block_list.text: —Whoa!! Is that a brand new machine!? Being the first to use it is so auspicious~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WHIRRRR, CLANK-CLANK-CLANK...!)

text_block_list.name: Machikane Fukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Fungyazaaa~~~!? I'm left dangling in mid-aiiir~~~!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: On my way home after finishing work, I spotted the two of them chatting in the academy plaza.

text_block_list.name: Machikane Fukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Miracle-san... thank you very much for saving me.

text_block_list.name: Machikane Fukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Haah... looking back on it... today was truly... truly...

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text: Fukukitaru... cheer up. Tomorrow, I'm sure something good will—

text_block_list.name: Machikane Fukukitaru
text_block_list.text: AN ULTRA GREAT FORTUNE DAY~~!!

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text: —Eh? ...I-It was?

text_block_list.name: Machikane Fukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Of course it was~! A meal packed with nutrients, full-power sprinting, and full-body workouts! Truly athletic and absolutely perfect!

text_block_list.name: Machikane Fukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Happy Great Fortune, thank you Shiraoki-sama! Everywhere I went brought massive good luck!

text_block_list.name: Machikane Fukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Such a lucky day deserves an elegant conclusion! Like having a tea break in the cafeteria...

text_block_list.name: Machikane Fukukitaru
text_block_list.text: —Wait!? W-Where is my wallet~~!? Don't tell me I left it in the locker room~~!?

text_block_list.name: Machikane Fukukitaru
text_block_list.text: My happiness power is overflowing endlessly! I feel like running all the way back to the dorm—

text_block_list.name: Machikane Fukukitaru
text_block_list.text: —Wait!? A sharp cramp just struck~!? M-My leg is cramping up~~!

text_block_list.name: Machikane Fukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Mfufu. While this lucky momentum is still going strong... Miracle-san! Please train with me tomorrow too—

text_block_list.name: Machikane Fukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
――Wait, what!? Ouch-ouch-ouch~!?
M-M-Muscle aches~!?
